purpose: Phase-4C ENDOCYTOSIS & INTRACELLULAR TRAFFICKING registry. Defines ONLY: the endocytosis pathways, the per-formulation uptake/escape/trafficking profile, the strict finite-state machine, the intracellular compartments (early/late endosome + lysosome), and per-species evidence for endocytosis + trafficking. It is a SEPARATE layer that READS the uptake/transport outputs and modifies nothing upstream. The code hardcodes NO biology or constants - pathways, probabilities, dwell times, escape and evidence all live here. NOTHING beyond intracellular trafficking is defined (no nucleus, DNA/RNA, PD, PK, signalling, apoptosis, immune, tumour killing, etc.).
authoritative_source: data/profile-b-evidence-package.json (FROZEN). Chen 2012 observed CELLULAR UPTAKE of the NLC in HaCaT (human) and B16BL6 (mouse) cells (order cationic > neutral > anionic) but did NOT resolve the endocytic PATHWAY, and reported NO endosomal escape. Rat had no cell-uptake study. So endocytosis + trafficking are PREDICTIVE for this formulation and escape is UNAVAILABLE (no escape).

evidence_review.note: Literature review categorised per the phase brief. These are GENERAL mechanism strengths; the per-species FORMULATION evidence level is separate (species_endocytosis / species_trafficking).

A_strong_experimental.note: early -> late endosome maturation is textbook cell biology
late endosome -> lysosome delivery is textbook cell biology

evidence_review.formulation_specific_note: For THIS NLC: the pathway is NOT resolved (uptake observed, mechanism unreported) and escape is NOT REPORTED. General mechanisms are category A/B, but the formulation-specific claim is PREDICTIVE (endocytosis + trafficking) or UNAVAILABLE (escape).

pathways.note: ONLY these three pathways are implemented. phagocytosis, receptor-specific internalization, Fc receptors, antibody uptake, active-transporter uptake, lipid-raft signalling and exocytosis are NOT implemented.

clathrin_mediated.label: Clathrin-mediated endocytosis
clathrin_mediated.visual: hexagonal lattice pit deepens -> vesicle pinches off

macropinocytosis.label: Macropinocytosis
macropinocytosis.visual: large membrane ruffle -> cup -> closure -> large vesicle

formulations.note: Per-formulation endocytosis profile (registry data - never hard-coded). pathway_weights choose the pathway; endocytosis_probability gates whether a contacting carrier internalises; escape controls endosomal escape; trafficking_profile sets maturation dwell (schematic steps). Values are FORMULATION-level (same across species); only the per-species EVIDENCE LEVEL differs - rat parameters are never copied into human because there are no per-species parameters to copy.

B1_nlc.pathway_basis: SCHEMATIC / PREDICTIVE - Chen observed cellular uptake (HaCaT/B16BL6) but did NOT resolve the pathway. Weights reflect a ~85-90 nm carrier (small-particle routes favoured over bulk macropinocytosis). NOT a measured distribution.

escape.basis: Endosomal escape is NOT REPORTED for this NLC in the frozen package -> no escape is animated; carriers terminate in the lysosome.

trafficking_profile.basis: SCHEMATIC dwell (simulation steps). Maturation TIMES are not reported for this formulation (NOT REPORTED); only the ordered sequence is claimed.

fsm.note: Strict finite-state machine. Every carrier has exactly one state. Illegal transitions are rejected. Escape transitions are only taken when the formulation escape profile allows.

compartments.note: ONLY these intracellular compartments. NO Golgi, ER, mitochondria, nucleus, ribosomes or cytoskeleton.

lysosome.label: Lysosome
lysosome.note: schematic small acidic vesicle; NO enzymes, NO molecular machinery, NO degradation chemistry

species_endocytosis.note: Endocytosis Evidence per species. The pathway is unresolved for this formulation, so endocytosis is PREDICTIVE for ALL species (MECHANISTIC_TRANSFER). Human/mouse have observational uptake support; rat has none. No rat parameters copied; no permeation citation claimed.

rat.observational_support: none - Chen used rat for skin permeation only; no rat cellular-uptake data.
rat.message: Endocytosis Evidence: Predictive. Carrier internalisation is shown from general endocytosis principles; the pathway is not resolved for this formulation and there is no rat cellular-uptake data. No quantitative uptake is claimed.

human.observational_support: HaCaT cellular uptake observed in vitro (Chen 2012; pathway unresolved).
human.message: Endocytosis Evidence: Predictive. Cellular uptake was observed in vitro (HaCaT), but the endocytic pathway and its rate have not been experimentally resolved for this formulation.

mouse.observational_support: B16BL6 cellular uptake observed in vitro (Chen 2012; pathway unresolved).
mouse.message: Endocytosis Evidence: Predictive. Cellular uptake was observed in vitro (B16BL6), but the endocytic pathway and its rate have not been experimentally resolved for this formulation.

species_trafficking.note: Intracellular Trafficking Evidence per species. Early->late endosome->lysosome maturation is general cell biology (category A) but is NOT measured for this formulation, so it is PREDICTIVE for all species.

rat.message: Intracellular Trafficking Evidence: Predictive. Endosome -> lysosome maturation is general cell biology; it is not measured for this formulation, so only the ordered sequence is shown (no timing claimed).

human.message: Intracellular Trafficking Evidence: Predictive. Endosome -> lysosome maturation is general cell biology; not measured for this formulation.

mouse.message: Intracellular Trafficking Evidence: Predictive. Endosome -> lysosome maturation is general cell biology; not measured for this formulation.

integrity.reads_only: The endocytosis engine READS the uptake/transport outputs (carriers + cells) read-only and modifies NO upstream engine. Its state (per-carrier FSM) lives only in the endocytosis engine.
integrity.carrier_vs_molecule: Endocytosis applies ONLY to CARRIER nanoparticles. Free drug molecules stay free (passive uptake, Phase 4B). Carriers and molecules are never the same object.
integrity.ends_at: Ends at the LYSOSOME (no escape) or, only when the formulation escape profile supports it, at the CYTOPLASM after ESCAPED. Nothing beyond intracellular trafficking.
